hero.title: Questions, answered
hero.subtitle: Everything you might want to know before getting started with StayLine.

items.a: StayLine is a platform that runs your hotel's guest communication over WhatsApp. It drafts AI replies, classifies each request and notifies the right on-shift staff, with dashboards and reports on top.

items.q: Do guests need to install an app?
items.a: No. Guests use the WhatsApp they already have and message your hotel's number — nothing to download.

items.q: Which WhatsApp API do you use?
items.a: The official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API. You connect your own verified WhatsApp Business number and Meta-approved message templates.

items.q: Does the AI reply automatically or just suggest?
items.a: Both — it's your choice. AI can draft replies for staff to send with one tap, or auto-reply. You can toggle it per hotel and per conversation.
Guests can write in their own language. StayLine detects the language and translates messages in both directions, storing both the original and the translation.

items.q: How does staff get notified of requests?
items.a: When a message arrives, AI classifies it and the on-shift staff for that department receive it as a WhatsApp message. If no one is on shift, it falls back to the department phone, then to managers.

items.q: Is our data secure and where is it stored?
items.a: Access is role-scoped per hotel, authentication uses short-lived tokens kept server-side, and processing relies on trusted providers (Meta for WhatsApp, Anthropic for AI). See our Privacy Policy for details.

items.q: Can it import our PMS guest list?
items.a: Yes. You can bulk-import guests from your PMS export, and conversations are matched to guests automatically by phone number.

items.q: Can we use our own WhatsApp number and templates?
items.a: Yes. StayLine uses your verified WhatsApp Business number and your Meta-approved templates.
No. The WhatsApp Cloud API doesn't support sending to groups, so staff notifications are delivered as 1:1 messages.
Request a demo and we'll help you connect your WhatsApp number, import guests, and configure departments and shifts.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
intro: This Privacy Policy explains how StayLine ("StayLine", "we", "us") collects, uses and protects personal data when hotels use our platform to communicate with their guests over WhatsApp.

StayLine is operated by İsmail Akkul (Red X Eight). For most guest personal data, the hotel using StayLine is the data controller and StayLine acts as a data processor on the hotel's behalf. For our own website visitors and account holders, StayLine is the controller.
If you have questions about this policy or want to exercise your rights, contact us at info@stayline.net.

sections.heading: Who we are and our role
body: StayLine is a hotel guest-communication platform. Hotels connect their WhatsApp Business number and use StayLine to receive guest messages, reply with AI assistance, route requests to staff, and view analytics.

When a hotel processes its guests' personal data through StayLine, the hotel is the controller and decides why and how that data is used. StayLine processes it under the hotel's instructions as a processor.

sections.heading: Data we collect
body: Depending on how the hotel uses StayLine, we may process the following categories of personal data:
bullets: Guest profile data: first and last name, phone number, email, nationality, date of birth, room number, check-in and check-out dates, reservation number, agency or booking source, VIP status and free-text notes.
Conversation data: WhatsApp contact identifier (phone number), message content (original and translated), media references, message status and timestamps, and whether a message was AI-generated.
Staff / account data: username, name, email, role, WhatsApp phone for notifications, and last login.
Technical data for our website: basic request information needed to serve and secure the site.

sections.heading: How we use data
body: We use personal data to operate the service: to deliver and translate WhatsApp messages, generate AI reply suggestions, classify and route requests to the right staff, match conversations to guests, and produce dashboards and reports for the hotel. For account holders, we use data to provide access, security and support.

sections.heading: Legal bases
body: Where the GDPR applies, processing relies on legitimate interests (operating and securing the service), the performance of a contract (providing the platform to the hotel), and, where required, consent obtained by the hotel from its guests. Where Turkish KVKK applies, we process data on the corresponding legal grounds, including the performance of a contract and our legitimate interests.
Hotels are responsible for obtaining any guest consent required for WhatsApp messaging under applicable law and Meta's WhatsApp Business policies.

sections.heading: WhatsApp and Meta
body: Messaging is delivered through the Meta WhatsApp Cloud API. Message content and phone numbers are processed by Meta Platforms in order to send and receive messages. Your use of WhatsApp is also subject to Meta's and WhatsApp's own terms and privacy policies.

sections.heading: AI processing
body: Reply suggestions, request classification and translation are performed using Claude, an AI service provided by Anthropic. Relevant message content and limited guest context are sent to Anthropic to generate these outputs. We do not use guest data to train any AI models, including our own or third-party foundation models.

sections.heading: Sub-processors
body: We rely on a limited set of service providers to run StayLine:
bullets: Meta Platforms — WhatsApp Cloud API message delivery.
Anthropic — Claude AI for reply generation, classification and translation.
Our hosting and infrastructure provider — Hostinger (Europe — Germany) — for application hosting and databases.

sections.heading: Sharing data
body: We do not sell personal data. We share it only with the sub-processors above as needed to provide the service, with the hotel that controls the data, and where required by law.

sections.heading: Data retention
body: We retain personal data for as long as the hotel maintains its account and as needed to provide the service, unless a longer period is required by law. Hotels can update or remove guest records, and deletion requests can be sent to info@stayline.net.

sections.heading: Security
body: We apply appropriate technical and organizational measures, including role-based access scoped per hotel, short-lived authentication tokens kept server-side, and encrypted connections. No system is perfectly secure, but we work to protect data against unauthorized access, loss or misuse.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: Subject to applicable law, individuals may request access to their personal data, correction, deletion, restriction or objection to processing, and data portability. Because the hotel is usually the controller of guest data, we may direct guest requests to the relevant hotel, or act on the hotel's instructions.
bullets: To exercise your rights, email info@stayline.net.
Guests can also contact the hotel they stayed at.

sections.heading: International transfers
body: Our providers may process data in countries other than your own. Where required, we rely on appropriate safeguards, such as standard contractual clauses, for international transfers.

sections.heading: Cookies
body: This marketing website is intentionally minimal and does not use advertising or tracking cookies. The application may use strictly necessary cookies or tokens to keep you signed in.

sections.heading: Children's data
body: StayLine is a tool for hotel operations and is not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy from time to time. We will revise the "last updated" date above and, where appropriate, notify hotels of material changes.

sections.heading: Contact
body: For any privacy question or request, contact info@stayline.net.

dataDeletion.title: Data Deletion
intro: This page explains how to request deletion of personal data associated with StayLine.
StayLine processes hotel guest data on behalf of hotels. In most cases the hotel that collected the data is the controller, and we act on its instructions.

sections.heading: Request deletion by email
body: To request deletion of your personal data, send an email to info@stayline.net. There is no form to fill out — a simple email is enough.
Please include enough detail for us to verify the request and locate your data.
bullets: Email: info@stayline.net
Tell us which data or account the request concerns (for example, your name and the hotel involved).
Include enough information for us to identify you, so we can verify the request.

sections.heading: What happens next
body: We will acknowledge your request and act on it in line with applicable law. Where StayLine is a processor, we may forward the request to, or confirm it with, the hotel that controls the data. We will delete or anonymize the relevant personal data unless we are required to keep it by law.

We aim to acknowledge your request within 5 business days and to complete deletion or anonymization within 30 days. Where StayLine acts as a processor, this timing may depend on the hotel that controls the data, and a longer period may apply where required by law.

sections.heading: Hotels using StayLine
body: If you are a StayLine customer (a hotel), you can also delete or update guest records directly from your account. For help, contact info@stayline.net.
